integrity: The full dihedral character is proved by a relative-chain Hopf trace argument; finite checks corroborate rather than replace the parameter-uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes ordinary 3-cut complexes of squared cycles with n>=9, rational coefficients, and the published nonequivariant shellability theorem; integral representations, equivariant homotopy and n<9 are not classified. Equivalent unindexed literature may exist.
title: Full dihedral homology characters of three-cut complexes of squared cycles
